title: Bifurcation Analysis of a Reaction-Diffusion System with a Cognitive Map Memory Kernel
summary: This paper investigates a single species reaction-diffusion system incorporating a spatiotemporal delay memory kernel, which models the cognitive map of animals, under Neumann boundary conditions. The model can be used to describe the process in which individuals are influenced by historical information during spatial diffusion. An equivalent system construction method with auxiliary variables is introduced to transform the original system into a delay-free coupled reaction-diffusion equation.
